name: Meet Your Dream
source: Meet Your Dream. This is the name of the game. And the name of the game within the game. We gave it for a reason, and the authors of the game in the game - even more so. Their project is a multiplayer RPG, plain in appearance, and seemingly unremarkable except for its impudent slogan. "You will meet your dream!" it promises ambitiously. The players did not take it seriously. But they should have. The game tends to keep promises.
translation: 《Meet Your Dream》——这是这款游戏的名字，也是游戏中那款游戏的名字。我们给它起这个名字自有理由，而游戏里的开发者更是如此。他们的项目是一款外表朴素的多人RPG，除了那句张狂的口号之外，看起来平平无奇：“你会遇见梦想中的人！”它信誓旦旦地承诺。玩家们并未当真，但他们本该当真，因为这款游戏一向会兑现承诺。
